 Print ​Motivational quote of the day by Dwayne Johnson: ‘Maybe these opportunities weren’t coming my way because I was too scared,’ a powerful life lesson on fear, taking chances and stepping outside your comfort zone(Image Credit: Instagram) The Rock has etched his name as one of the biggest WWE superstars of all time. While there have been many other names from the Anoa'i family who paved the way, arguably, The Great One is at the top of all of them. This would naturally mean that any of his relatives would get an easy path to enter WWE. In fact, one of his cousins is a top star in WWE today. She is none other than Nia Jax, who made a cold statement about the prevailing debate over nepotism in the company. The Rock's cousin Nia Jax on nepotism favoring her in WWE
 In a recent interview on the Battleground Podcast, Nia Jax spoke about her tenure in WWE and how it began. The Irresistible Force said that she initially kept quiet about her rich lineage to find out if she had the merit to become a WWE superstar. Nia said, “Yeah, I mean, I think it’s so, you know, when I first tried out, like, I tried not to let anybody know that I was related to, you know, The Rock and the big Samoan dynasty because I wanted to hopefully get through with my own merits. " When asked about fans heckling her for getting opportunities because of The Rock and her family, Jax did not downplay it and said that nepotism was great. She acknowledged that she got an easy entry into the WWE system, but proved her worth in the tryouts and eventually went on to become a top star in the current WWE women's division. Join conversation

 Watch Nia Jax on WWE “Nepotism” and Building Her Own Legacy She said, "It’s like, well, nepotism is a great thing, you know what I mean? I’m not going to sit there and negate all the accomplishments my family has made in this business. Like, I get to be a part of it. It’s incredible. And I’m not, like, I got an opportunity to try out just like everybody else does, and I made it. So there’s no reason for me not to be proud of my family and not to be proud of what they’ve accomplished." Nia Jax has been a multi-time WWE Women's Champion, one of the few women to compete in a Men's Royal Rumble, and has achieved other major accolades. Despite the criticism, Jax continues to move forward and carve out her own path in the TKO-led company.
